summary: 2026 FIA WEC campaign (BMW M Hybrid V8 #15/#20, BMW M4 GT3 EVO #32/#69). BMW M is the team title (front). WEC programme partners named by BMW's press release: Shell (Premium Technology Partner, on the #20 car), Akrapovič, Champion, XPEL, H&R, OZ Racing, KYB and PUMA. Team partners from WRT's own partners page: Skechers, Snap-on, OMP Racing and Technogym. Further partners of the BMW M Motorsport programme from BMW M's official partner page: Michelin, Schaeffler, Synopsys, Yokohama, AccuSim, Endless, MdynamiX, MOTORWORLD, RAVENOL and RoboMarkets. Race-livery placements (per-car logos, one-off liveries such as the #69 Fuji design) do not fit the schema yet and are not recorded.
